{{Expand Italian|topic=bio|Edoardo Vesentini|date=March 2020}}
{{Short description|Italian mathematician and politician (1928–2020)}}
[[File:Edoardo Vesentini.jpg|thumb|upright|Edoardo Vesentini in 1967]]
'''Edoardo Vesentini''' (31 May 1928 – 28 March 2020) was an Italian mathematician and politician who introduced the [[Andreotti–Vesentini theorem]]. He was awarded the [[Caccioppoli Prize]] in 1962.

He was elected a member of the [[Academia Europaea]] in 1989.<ref>{{cite web|title=Edoardo Vesentini|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Vesentini_Edoardo|work=Member|publisher=Academia Europaea|access-date=2024-12-04}}</ref>

Vasentini was born in [[Rome]], and died on 28 March 2020, aged 91.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lanazione.it/pisa/cronaca/moro-edoardo-vesentini-1.5085240 |title=E' morto Edoardo Vesentini, direttore emerito della Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa |website=LaNazione.it|date=28 March 2020 }}</ref>
